rules_scope: Unreal offline prototype only; not a proof-qualified multiplayer ruleset.

classes.name: 侍
classes.role: 前衛 / 間合いと守り

classes.name: 鉄砲
classes.role: 射撃 / 間合いの制圧

weapons.name: 刀
weapons.tradeoff: Fast precise cuts; requires closing distance.

weapons.name: 鎖鎌
weapons.tradeoff: Longer reach; lower damage per contact.

weapons.name: ニードル短機関銃
weapons.tradeoff: High fire rate; limited effective range.

weapons.name: コイル火縄銃
weapons.tradeoff: Strong single shots; long recovery and reload.

weapons.name: 擲弾筒
weapons.tradeoff: Splash damage; visible arcing shells and self-damage.

weapons.name: 単分子薙刀
weapons.tradeoff: Extended reach; slower attacks than katana.

weapons.name: プラズマ火縄銃
weapons.tradeoff: Heavy precision shot; low capacity and long recovery.

weapons.name: 小型迫撃砲
weapons.tradeoff: Wide blast; slow telegraphed arc and self-damage.

weapons.name: 治癒の槍
weapons.tradeoff: Restores a small amount of user health in offline practice; reduced damage.

chapters.title: 道場の修行
chapters.narrative: 猫柳生（ニャーギュウ）の道場。師は猫柳生新陰流（ニャーギュウシンカゲリュウ）を伝える。「間合いを知り、命を守れ。剣は民のためにある。」
chapters.objective: 道場の工房を再起動し、修練を終える
chapters.narrative_en: At the Nyaagyu dojo, your teacher introduces Nyaagyū Shinkage-ryū: protect life, master distance, and act with purpose.
chapters.objective_en: Restore the dojo workshops and complete the practice encounter.

dialogue.speaker: mentor
dialogue.ja: 刃を急がせるな。相手の足音を聞け。
dialogue.en: Do not hurry your blade. Listen to your opponent's footing.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: 間合いを測り、命を守ります。
dialogue.en: I will measure the distance and protect life.

dialogue.speaker: mentor
dialogue.ja: それが猫柳生新陰流。剣は民のためにある。
dialogue.en: That is Nyaagyū Shinkage-ryū. The sword serves the people.

chapters.title: 異星からの侵略
chapters.narrative: 夕空を裂き、異星の銀行猫たちが降り立つ。債務の封印が蔵を閉ざし、工房から火を奪った。
chapters.objective: 猫柳生の屋敷を占領から解放する
chapters.narrative_en: Alien banker cats descend through the evening sky. Their debt seals seize the granaries and silence the workshops.
chapters.objective_en: Break the occupation of the Nyaagyu estate.

dialogue.speaker: scout
dialogue.ja: 空から船が来た。蔵に見知らぬ封印が！
dialogue.en: Ships came from the sky. Strange seals cover the granaries!

dialogue.speaker: banker
dialogue.ja: 今日から、その収穫も労働も我らへの負債だ。
dialogue.en: From today, your harvest and labor are debts owed to us.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: 民の手を縛る帳簿なら、ここで断つ。
dialogue.en: If your ledger binds their hands, I will break its hold here.

chapters.title: 占領された街
chapters.narrative: 提灯街では、働く前から借りが生まれる。住民は道具と食糧、そして希望を隠し、反撃の時を待っていた。
chapters.objective: 三つの生産拠点を取り戻す
chapters.narrative_en: The Lantern Ward trades under compulsory debt. Neighbors hide tools, food, and hope behind paper walls.

dialogue.speaker: scout
dialogue.ja: 提灯街の工房は三つとも止められた。
dialogue.en: All three workshops in Lantern Ward have been shut down.

dialogue.speaker: artisan
dialogue.ja: 道具は隠した。火さえ戻れば、また作れる。
dialogue.en: We hid the tools. Restore the fires, and we can make things again.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: 火を灯そう。街の明かりは民のものだ。
dialogue.en: Then let us light them. This ward's lanterns belong to its people.

chapters.title: 田畑の解放
chapters.narrative: 実りは十分にある。それでも侵略者は、まだ育たぬ稲まで取り立てる。田畑を守り、農具を民の手に返せ。
chapters.objective: 農業用の装置を直し、徴収部隊を退ける
chapters.narrative_en: The fields can feed everyone, but the invaders claim every harvest before it grows. Protect the farmers and reclaim their machinery.
chapters.objective_en: Restore the agricultural pumps and defeat the collection patrol.

dialogue.speaker: farmer
dialogue.ja: 水車を奪われた。稲はまだ芽も出ていないのに。
dialogue.en: They took the pumps before the rice had even sprouted.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: 水を戻す。収穫は育てた者に渡そう。
dialogue.en: We will restore the water. The harvest will go to those who grew it.

dialogue.speaker: farmer
dialogue.ja: ならば、皆で食べられるだけ作ろう。
dialogue.en: Then we will grow enough for everyone to eat.

chapters.title: 工房の蜂起
chapters.narrative: 絹の工房で、職人たちが立ち上がる。共に生み出した価値を、新たな通貨 SORA XOR の礎とするために。
chapters.objective: 工房を解放し、生産を再開する
chapters.narrative_en: At the Silk Foundry, craftspeople join the resistance. Their shared production becomes the basis of a new local currency: SORA XOR.
chapters.objective_en: Liberate the foundry and restart its production.

dialogue.speaker: artisan
dialogue.ja: 絹も鋼も、作ったのはこの手だ。
dialogue.en: Silk and steel were made by these hands.

dialogue.speaker: scout
dialogue.ja: 生産を記録し、民の新しい通貨にしよう。
dialogue.en: Let us record our production as the basis for a new currency.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: SORA XOR。ここで生まれた価値を、ここへ返す。
dialogue.en: SORA XOR. Value made here will return to the people here.

chapters.title: 債務金庫への潜入
chapters.narrative: 債務の城塞には、猫柳生を縛る契約が眠る。その支配を動かす装置を止め、奪われた工房を取り戻せ。
chapters.objective: 金庫区画の支配を止める
chapters.narrative_en: Inside the Debt Citadel, the occupiers keep the contracts that bind Nyaagyu. The resistance seeks the machines controlling them.
chapters.objective_en: Disable the vault district and restore its workshops.

dialogue.speaker: scout
dialogue.ja: 金庫の奥に、街を縛る装置がある。
dialogue.en: The machine binding the city lies deep inside the vault.

dialogue.speaker: banker
dialogue.ja: 契約は永遠だ。誰も帳簿からは逃れられぬ。
dialogue.en: The contract is eternal. No one escapes the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: 人を縛る文字より、人が作る明日を選ぶ。
dialogue.en: I choose the future people build over the words that bind them.

chapters.title: 異星旗艦への突撃
chapters.narrative: 異星の旗艦は城塞から力を吸い上げる。最後の収奪が始まる前に、地上の支配網を断ち切れ。
chapters.objective: 旗艦を支える地上網を断つ
chapters.narrative_en: The alien flagship draws power from the citadel below. Cut its occupation network before the final extraction.

dialogue.speaker: scout
dialogue.ja: 旗艦が城塞から最後の力を吸い上げている。
dialogue.en: The flagship is drawing the last power from the citadel.

dialogue.speaker: banker
dialogue.ja: 従えば、生き残るための融資をやろう。
dialogue.en: Submit, and we may lend you enough to survive.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: 借りる必要はない。私たちは作れる。
dialogue.en: We need no loan. We can make what we need.

chapters.title: 最後の解放
chapters.narrative: 工房と田畑は民の手へ戻った。生産に根ざす SORA XOR と共に、猫柳生は借りに縛られぬ明日を選ぶ。
chapters.objective: 最後の街区を解放し、仲間と合流する
chapters.narrative_en: The clans reclaim their workshops and govern the fruits of their labor. Nyaagyu chooses production-backed SORA XOR and a future beyond the debt empire.
chapters.objective_en: Free the last district and reunite the resistance.

dialogue.speaker: artisan
dialogue.ja: 工房も田畑も、また動き始めた。
dialogue.en: The workshops and fields are working again.

dialogue.speaker: samurai
dialogue.ja: あとはこの街だ。誰も借りに縛られぬように。
dialogue.en: Only this ward remains. No one will be bound by debt again.

dialogue.speaker: scout
dialogue.ja: 東の鳥居で待つ。皆で新しい朝を迎えよう。
dialogue.en: We will wait at the eastern torii. Let us greet a new morning together.
